surfaces: [readme, chapter]
readme_bullet: "**Source-gated TV wear sampling** — attribute HDMI-connected Samsung TV wear from local frames only while the TV is showing that input."
---
User can now: sample compositor-driven wear on an HDMI-connected Samsung TV without counting local frames while the TV shows another source.

Detail: A declared compositor output and persisted portal position bind consent to the intended panel. Samsung IP Control source polling falls back to tagged uniform attribution whenever the configured HDMI source is not visible or cannot be read.
